actions.text: Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 119-247.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans awarded the Purple Heart for service on or after September 11, 2001, and their designated dependents.
dimensions.evidence: authorizes certain Purple Heart recipients to elect to transfer to one or more eligible dependents... unused portions of such recipients' entitlement

dimensions.assessment: Provides substantial educational benefit opportunities for family members through transferred GI Bill entitlements up to 36 months.
dimensions.evidence: total number of months of entitlement transferred by an individual under this section may not exceed 36 months

dimensions.assessment: Involves federal educational assistance funding through the Department of Veterans Affairs, though exact cost estimates are not provided.
dimensions.evidence: rate of educational assistance payable to a dependent... shall be payable at the same rate as such entitlement would otherwise be payable

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38, United States Code, to create a new transfer authority and coordinate administrative duties between the VA and DOD.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs and the Secretary of Defense shall coordinate with each other to facilitate the transfer of entitlement

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory authorization for eligible veterans to transfer benefits, subject to dependent age limitations.

missing_information: Total number of eligible Purple Heart recipients who would take advantage of the transfer
Detailed federal cost estimates for the transferred educational benefits
importance_detail.rationale: Allows qualifying Purple Heart veterans to transfer up to 36 months of unused Post-9/11 GI Bill educational assistance to eligible family members.
